from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List

class DocumentExtraction(BaseModel):
    """Extraction from a single judgment document."""
    document_title: str = Field(description="Full title of the judgment document")
    case_nature: str | None = Field(description="Broad nature of the case: Criminal, Administrative, or State Compensation")
    core_dispute: str | None = Field(description="The primary legal dispute or administrative act type")
    involved_subjects: list[str] = Field(description="Government bodies or individuals involved")
    cited_laws: list[str] = Field(description="Specific laws or regulations cited")
    key_facts: list[str] = Field(description="Key facts supporting the charge or claim")
    judgment_outcome: str | None = Field(description="Summary of the final ruling or decision")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentExtraction]
